operations.text: 0.3.24 corrects the self-check, not the gates. On Linux and macOS the full self-check of 0.3.23 printed two red rows, both named (p2) main + R2 open, under GATE 3 SURFACE and GATE 3 PLANNING: they still expected the decision from before 0.3.23 for a root-level file whose name holds backslashes and ends in .md. The gates were right - such a file is a root-level markdown file and passes Gate 3 as one - and the two rows now assert that. Nothing changes on Windows, nothing is re-rendered and no file of yours changes.
